title: Restructure documentation for independent protocol website with Fumadocs root categories
body:
## Documentation Structure Restructuring

Successfully restructured the documentation for the ObjectStack Protocol as an independent protocol website with proper Fumadocs root category organization.

### Changes Made

**1. Internal Documentation Organization**
- Moved planning docs (DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md, PRIORITIES.md, PLANNING_INDEX.md, etc.) to `/internal/planning/`
- Created `/internal/README.md` to document the internal directory structure
- Separated internal planning documents from public protocol documentation

**2. Consolidated Documentation Structure**
- Merged all technical documentation from `/docs/` into `/content/docs/`
- Removed redundant `/docs/` directory
- Created single source of truth for all documentation

**3. Fumadocs Root Categories**
Established seven clear top-level navigation categories with `"root": true`:
- **Quick Start** - Essential first steps for getting started
- **Tutorials** - Step-by-step learning guides
- **Guides** - Developer how-to guides (includes migration)
- **Concepts** - Philosophy and architectural concepts
- **Specifications** - Protocol specifications (includes architecture deep dives)
- **Standards** - Development standards and conventions
- **References** - Complete API reference documentation

**4. Hierarchical Organization**
- `/content/docs/specifications/architecture/` - Architecture deep dives (ObjectQL, ObjectUI, ObjectOS)
- `/content/docs/guides/migration/` - Version migration guides
- `/content/docs/guides/advanced/` - Advanced technical guides (AI integration, security, performance)
- `/content/docs/standards/` - Naming conventions, API design, error handling, authentication

**5. Format and Navigation Improvements**
- Converted all `.md` files to `.mdx` format with proper frontmatter
- Created `meta.json` files for all sections with `"root": true` for top-level categories
- Created index pages for improved navigation
- Added title and description metadata to all documentation files

**6. Link Updates**
- Updated all cross-references in README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, and .github/prompts/README.md
- Fixed all broken links to point to new locations
- Updated GitHub repository links for moved files
- Verified all navigation paths are working

**7. Meta.json Verification and Fixes**
- Verified all 41 meta.json files in the documentation structure
- Removed incorrect `"root": true` flags from References sub-directories (data, ui, system, ai, api)
- Added Chinese meta.json files for all 7 root categories (quick-start, tutorials, guides, concepts, specifications, standards, references)
- Updated existing Chinese meta.json files to match English structure
- Ensured proper hierarchical structure with no nested root categories

### Final Documentation Structure

```
content/docs/
├── quick-start/           [ROOT] Essential getting started guides
├── tutorials/             [ROOT] Step-by-step learning
├── guides/                [ROOT] Developer guides
│   ├── advanced/          # AI integration, security, performance
│   └── migration/         # Version migration guides
├── concepts/              [ROOT] Philosophy and core concepts
├── specifications/        [ROOT] Protocol specifications
│   ├── architecture/      # ObjectQL, ObjectUI, ObjectOS deep dives
│   ├── data/             # Data layer specs
│   ├── ui/               # UI layer specs
│   └── server/           # Server specs
├── standards/             [ROOT] Development standards
├── references/            [ROOT] Complete API reference
│   ├── data/             # Data protocol reference
│   ├── ui/               # UI protocol reference
│   ├── system/           # System protocol reference
│   ├── ai/               # AI protocol reference
│   └── api/              # API protocol reference
├── faq.mdx               # Frequently asked questions
└── troubleshooting.mdx   # Troubleshooting guide
```

### Testing

- ✅ Documentation site builds successfully
- ✅ All 618 pages generated without errors
- ✅ All internal links verified and working
- ✅ Navigation structure properly configured with 7 root categories
- ✅ All 41 meta.json files verified and corrected
- ✅ Chinese versions available for all root categories
- ✅ Hierarchical organization improves discoverability

### Benefits

1. **Clear Navigation**: Seven clear root categories make it easy to find information
2. **Logical Grouping**: Related content is grouped together (architecture under specifications, migration under guides)
3. **Scalability**: Structure supports future growth with clear categorization
4. **Protocol-First**: Focus on protocol documentation with proper technical depth
5. **User-Friendly**: Different user journeys (quick start, tutorials, references) are well-separated
6. **Internationalization**: Complete Chinese support for all navigation
7. **Correct Hierarchy**: No nested root categories, proper parent-child relationships

The documentation is now properly organized as an independent protocol website with clear separation between public documentation and internal planning materials, and a clean, scalable structure suitable for both new users and experienced developers.
